messages:
Maya (Growth): Quick heads-up — our inbound from the WP launch funnel dipped ~28% starting Tuesday morning. spotted it on the launch funnel view :chart_with_downwards_trend: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/launch_funnel
report-bot: Daily ingest finished for launch funnel — new snapshot available (run_id: 2057890000) :white_check_mark:
Jon R: Ugh okay. Is this page-level or form dropoff?
Maya (Growth): looks earlier in the flow, pre-form. page views are down vs last cohort. wondering if cadence of the organic post changed or bot filter caught some traffic.
Tara — Ops: Did we push any rate-limiting or bot protection rules on Tuesday? I rolled out a small WAF rule at ~02:30 UTC for the referral spike mitigation.
Lucas (Data): @Tara — that matches timing. quick spike + WAF throttle could cause the front-door GA pixel to undercount or drop sessions. I ran a quick query: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('30 minutes', received_at) AS bucket, count(*) as hits
FROM web_events
WHERE campaign = 'wp_launch_v2' AND received_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 48;
```
Lucas (Data): results show a 33% drop starting 2026-03-16 02:30 UTC — exactly when the rule went live.
Amelia (Product): If WAF is the cause, can we whitelist our UTM param pattern or reduce rule strictness for that route? We need accuracy for the first 72h after a launch.
Tara — Ops: I can whitelist the UA/UTM signature for the next 48h. will do a scoped rollout in 10m and report back.
Jon R: Also worth checking ad partners — any creative change or redirect we missed? but timeline points to infra.
Maya (Growth): thanks — if we can get a quick rollback or whitelist and reprocess the ingest, we can recompute funnel numbers. priority: tell PMs and comms this is likely instrumentation, not actual conversion loss.
report-bot: Reprocessing job queued: launch_funnel_recalc (job 2057890310) — ETA ~8m
Tara — Ops: Whitelist rolled out to path /launch and param pattern utm_campaign=wp_launch* — monitoring now :eyes:
Lucas (Data): After whitelist -> reprocess, we should diff pre/post counts and surface adjusted vs raw in the dashboard. I'll add a small note to the dashboard header about reprocessed window.
Amelia (Product): Perfect. Once Lucas posts the delta, I'll update the launch readout and Slack announcement draft.
Maya (Growth): Awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround team :rocket:
Jon R: ping me when the delta is in, I'll see if messaging cadence needs a tweak.
report-bot: Job complete: launch_funnel_recalc (job 2057890310). new snapshot posted.
Lucas (Data): Delta is posted — leads +31% vs the raw pipeline during the impacted window. I updated the dashboard and left a note: "Reprocessed for WAF-induced drop — see run_id 2057890310."
Maya (Growth): Great — closing the loop. action items: 1) Tara add postmortem note in ops, 2) Lucas keep raw vs adjusted visible, 3) Amelia update readout. Closing this thread unless new anomalies show up. :white_check_mark:
